name: Elixir of Agony
summary: In the Undercity, Faranell prepares Lydon's mixture for a deadly purpose. The Royal Apothecary Society's new plague needs coastal reagents and alchemical draughts before the brew can be used.

sections.title: A Colloid of Decay
sections.body: Apothecary Lydon sent his Mudsnout Blossom mixture from gnoll-held Nethander Stead to the Apothecarium in the Undercity. Master Apothecary Faranell, head of the Royal Apothecary Society, saw its grim potential at once. Pleased by its toxic properties, he added his own colloid of decay. Then he named the catalysts needed to make the mixture a weapon.

sections.title: Catalysts from the Coast
sections.body: Lydon must gather precise reagents in Tarren Mill to activate the mixture's contaminating agents. Faranell calls for a restorative draught of Strong Troll's Blood to feed and steady the chemical reaction. He also needs organic parts from Hillsbrad's southern shore: scales from the serpentine Daggerspine naga and eyes from the coastal Torn Fin murlocs.

sections.title: Cruelty in Tarren Mill
sections.body: Back in Tarren Mill, Lydon passes the waiting hours by poisoning, infecting, and reanimating his undead test subject, Umpi. Faranell's enriched mixture and the coastal catalysts bring Lydon closer to perfecting an agonizing new strain of blight for the living settlements of Hillsbrad.

faq.q: Why does the plague require a restorative troll's blood elixir?
faq.answer: Restorative Strong Troll's Blood helps sustain, fuel, and rapidly mutate aggressive biological agents. Its properties keep the toxic cultures thriving long enough to react with the other tissues.

faq.q: Where are the Daggerspine scales found?
faq.answer: Daggerspine scales come from the hostile naga on Hillsbrad's eastern beaches, along the shore east of Southshore.

faq.q: Where are the Torn Fin eyes obtained?
faq.answer: Torn Fin eyes come from murloc tribes on Hillsbrad's western coast, just west of Southshore.
Umpi is the frog Apothecary Lydon keeps as his assistant in Tarren Mill. In his idle hours, Lydon uses her as a test subject, inflicting lethal toxins and diseases before reanimating her.

faq.q: Why is Master Apothecary Faranell involved in this local project?
faq.answer: Master Apothecary Faranell leads the Royal Apothecary Society and oversees research into biological agents and plagues. Field apothecaries such as Lydon send promising discoveries to Faranell in the Undercity for refinement and authorization.

Lydon's Mudsnout Mixture is an unrefined toxic blend made from Mudsnout Blossoms, foul mushrooms gathered at gnoll-infested Nethander Stead in the Hillsbrad Foothills. Seeing its unusual virulence, Lydon sent it to the Undercity, where Faranell added decayed colloids to make a deadlier contagion.

angles.text: Each refined reagent brings the Royal Apothecary Society closer to fulfilling Lady Sylvanas's desire for an ultimate weapon against the living.
Tarren Mill faces constant border skirmishes with the Alliance of Southshore. Lydon's toxic experiments aim to tip the regional balance of power.
